text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text:
"That's everything on the schedule for 
today, right? Thank you for your hard 
work—"

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text:
...Is that... a dog...? Why in a place 
like this...

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text:
A plastic bag...! To think I could mistake 
something like this...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Admire Groove seems to have built up 
fatigue from her races. I may need to 
review her schedule.
